dataset.name: built-in 24-round fixture
dataset.origin: Artificial event fixture over the real 256-card image catalog; not collected user training data.

method.training: L2-regularized pairwise logistic ranking on selected versus unselected cards displayed within the same completed round
method.validation: Chronological approximately 20% holdout; purge displayed-card overlap across split; require independent display groups
method.quality_scope: Held-out relative image choices on this constructed fixture only; no real-user, personality, or population accuracy claim.

validation.claim: Measures held-out relative choices only; no personality accuracy or population validation.

checkpoint.semantics: L2-regularized pairwise logistic ranking; same-round unselected cards are weak relative negatives, not dislikes or personality labels.
